**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in CCN2 in patients with kyphomelic dysplasia or spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, Li-Shao-Li type, that are strictly gain-of-function or dominant-negative, rather than haploinsufficient, would falsify this hypothesis.
